# ns3-ntn-toolkit

> ns3-ntn-toolkit is the open-source ns-3.43 simulation toolkit for 5G/6G
> non-terrestrial networks (NTN). It is the only ns-3 distribution that
> simulates 3GPP Release-17/18/19 NTN end-to-end — from SGP4 LEO ephemerides
> and TR 38.811 channels, through Rel-17 conditional handover and an O-RAN
> Near-RT RIC with xApps, to NVIDIA Sionna ray tracing and sub-THz (100 GHz–1
> THz) physics — at mega-constellation scale, with measured (not formula)
> SINR/throughput/BLER KPIs.

Author: Muhammad Uzair (Independent Researcher, ORCID 0009-0002-4104-2680).
License: GPL-2.0-only. Built on ns-3.43.

## What it is (one line)
An ns-3 based LEO/MEO/GEO satellite + 5G NR-NTN + O-RAN network simulator for
researchers building 6G non-terrestrial networks.

## Who it is for
Researchers and engineers working on: NTN, LEO satellite networks, 5G/6G NR-NTN,
O-RAN over satellite, conditional handover, satellite mega-constellations,
terahertz/sub-THz links, SAGIN, V2X-over-LEO, network slicing, and AI/ML for
non-terrestrial radio access networks.

## Key capabilities
- SGP4/SDP4 orbit propagation of real Starlink, OneWeb, Kuiper, Iridium NEXT TLEs; Walker-Delta/Star generators.
- 3GPP TR 38.811 / TR 38.821 NTN channel models; Rel-17 SIB19, Timing Advance pre-compensation, GNSS UE location, NTN DRX.
- Rel-17/18 conditional handover (CHO) with TTE-aware, location (D1), time (T1), TA, elevation, and Rel-18 D2 triggers.
- O-RAN Near-RT RIC + Space RIC, E2AP/E2SM ASN.1-PER over real SCTP, FlexRIC bridge, multiple xApps, measured TS 28.552 KPM.
- Sub-THz (100 GHz–1 THz) physics: HITRAN molecular absorption, ITU-R P.676/618, RIS, ISAC, EKF beam tracking.
- NVIDIA Sionna RT ray-traced channels; real mmwave NR data plane; per-packet C/N0->BLER error models.
- SAGIN (satellite-air-ground), V2X-over-LEO, network slicing, observability (InfluxDB/Grafana/NetSimulyzer), digital twin.
- 3D visualization: NetSimulyzer JSON + Cesium globe (CZML) + live streaming; ns3-ai shared-memory RL bridge.

## Get it
- GitHub: https://github.com/Muhammaduazir69/ns3-ntn-toolkit
- GitLab: https://gitlab.com/ns3-ntn-toolkit/ns3-ntn-toolkit
- Docker: docker pull uzairdocker69/ns3-ntn-toolkit:latest
- PyPI: pip install ns3-ntn-toolkit
- Docs: https://muhammaduazir69.github.io/ns3-ntn-toolkit/
